scope: Primary-source record and exact route contract for high-value New Jersey buyer-agreement, selling-timeline, probate, assessment-appeal, and neutral municipal-comparison pages.

cfpb-closing-disclosure.title: Explicación de la Divulgación de Cierre
cfpb-closing-disclosure.use: Sustenta la Divulgación de Cierre proporcionada por el prestamista y su período de revisión de tres días hábiles para las operaciones hipotecarias cubiertas.
cfpb-closing-disclosure.limit: La regla de divulgación es un requisito entre prestatario y prestamista para ciertos préstamos; no es un plazo universal de contrato ni de revisión por un abogado en Nueva Jersey.

cfpb-loan-estimate.title: Explicación de la Estimación del Préstamo
cfpb-loan-estimate.use: Sustenta la comparación y revisión de los términos del préstamo y costos de cierre estimados para una hipoteca cubierta antes del cierre.
cfpb-loan-estimate.limit: Una Estimación del Préstamo no es un compromiso de préstamo, informe de título, valoración de la propiedad ni predicción de la fecha de cierre.

irs-publication-559-2025.title: Publicación 559 (2025): sobrevivientes, albaceas y administradores
irs-publication-559-2025.use: Sustenta conceptos generales de la base tributaria federal de una propiedad heredada, incluida la regla habitual del valor justo de mercado a la fecha de fallecimiento y las excepciones indicadas.
irs-publication-559-2025.limit: La Publicación 559 ofrece información tributaria federal general; la titularidad, elecciones de valoración, declaraciones, mejoras, depreciación y hechos individuales requieren revisión profesional.

nj-oag-fair-housing.title: Discriminación en la vivienda

nar-open-house-guide.kind: orientación al consumidor sobre políticas de MLS
nar-open-house-guide.title: Guía del consumidor sobre jornadas de puertas abiertas y contratos escritos

nar-open-house-guide.limit: La guía señala expresamente que las prácticas varían según la ley estatal y local y que la propia guía del consumidor no cambia la política de NAR.

nar-written-buyer-agreements.title: Contratos escritos con compradores 101
nar-written-buyer-agreements.use: Sustenta la política para participantes de MLS antes de mostrar propiedades, la compensación determinable objetivamente, la divulgación de su carácter negociable y preguntas contractuales del consumidor.
nar-written-buyer-agreements.limit: Es orientación de una asociación profesional y de MLS, no legislación de Nueva Jersey ni sustituto de la ley estatal o de un contrato firmado.

nj-inheritance-estate-tax.title: Impuestos sobre herencias y patrimonios

nj-inheritance-estate-tax.limit: El tratamiento tributario depende del domicilio, fecha de fallecimiento, ubicación de los activos, clase de beneficiario, titularidad y declaraciones; la página no determina un patrimonio específico.

nj-inheritance-tax-forms.title: Formularios de impuestos sobre herencias y patrimonios

nj-inheritance-tax-forms.limit: El formulario y la presentación adecuados dependen del patrimonio; el directorio no autoriza una venta ni determina si una presentación está completa.

nj-tax-waiver-requirements.kind: orientación estatal sobre impuestos y transferencias

njcourts-county-surrogate.title: Sustituto del condado

njdobi-bulletin-24-11.title: Boletín 24-11: relaciones comerciales de corretaje inmobiliario, incluida la agencia designada

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Banking and Insurance
sources.title: Bulletin 24-11: Real Estate Brokerage Business Relationships, Including Designated Agency
sources.use: Supports New Jersey brokerage-services-agreement timing, required terms, negotiable compensation, permitted payors, and agency disclosures.
sources.limit: The bulletin summarizes P.L. 2024, c.32 and does not supply a consumer's negotiated contract terms or individual legal advice.

sources.title: Real Estate Frequently Asked Questions
sources.use: Supports the distinction between the Consumer Information Statement and the separate written agreement that establishes a buyer-agency relationship.
sources.limit: The FAQ does not replace the signed brokerage services agreement or advice from a New Jersey attorney about a particular contract.

sources.title: Written Buyer Agreements 101
sources.use: Supports the MLS-participant before-touring policy, objectively ascertainable compensation, negotiability disclosure, and consumer contract questions.
sources.limit: This is trade-association and MLS policy guidance, not New Jersey legislation and not a substitute for state law or a signed agreement.

sources.title: Consumer Guide to Open Houses and Written Agreements
sources.use: Supports the open-house exception when a consumer attends without their own agent and distinguishes marketing conversations from working with a buyer.
sources.limit: The guide expressly notes that practices vary with state and local law and that the consumer guide itself does not change NAR policy.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Banking and Insurance
sources.title: Consumer Information: Real Estate
sources.use: Identifies the Real Estate Commission's regulatory role and provides current access to New Jersey consumer real-estate materials.
sources.limit: The landing page is a source directory and does not determine any transaction's deadlines, contract terms, title issues, or closing date.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of Banking and Insurance
sources.title: Everything You Wanted to Know About Buying a Home
sources.use: Supports the limited statement that many New Jersey buyers retain attorneys although doing so is not required, plus contract-led inspection and title concepts.
sources.limit: The guide contains legacy federal-form references, so the rebuilt pages use it only for the narrow New Jersey statements identified and defer current loan forms to CFPB.

sources.title: Closing Disclosure Explainer
sources.use: Supports the lender-provided Closing Disclosure and its three-business-day review period for covered mortgage transactions.
sources.limit: The disclosure rule is a borrower-lender requirement for covered loans, not a universal New Jersey contract or attorney-review timetable.

sources.title: Loan Estimate Explainer
sources.use: Supports comparison and review of loan terms and estimated closing costs for a covered mortgage before a transaction reaches closing.
sources.limit: A Loan Estimate is not a commitment to lend, a title report, a property valuation, or a prediction of the closing date.

sources.title: Publication 559 (2025), Survivors, Executors, and Administrators
sources.use: Supports general federal inherited-property basis concepts, including the usual date-of-death fair-market-value rule and listed exceptions.
sources.limit: Publication 559 is general federal tax information; ownership, valuation elections, reporting, improvements, depreciation, and individual facts require professional review.

sources.title: Inheritance and Estate Tax
sources.use: Supports the continued New Jersey inheritance-tax framework and the end of New Jersey estate tax for decedents dying on or after January 1, 2018.
sources.limit: Tax treatment depends on domicile, date of death, asset location, beneficiary class, title, and filings; the page is not an estate-specific conclusion.

sources.title: Tax Waiver Requirements for a Decedent's Property
sources.use: Supports the need to determine whether a New Jersey tax waiver applies before transferring property held in a decedent's name.
sources.limit: The source lists exceptions and fact-specific routes; a webpage cannot determine waiver status, title authority, or filing obligations for an estate.

sources.title: Inheritance and Estate Tax Forms
sources.use: Provides the current state directory for inheritance-tax returns and waiver-related forms, including real-property waiver request forms.
sources.limit: The appropriate form and filing depend on the estate; the directory does not authorize a sale or determine whether a filing is complete.

sources.title: County Surrogate
sources.use: Supports the county surrogate's role in uncontested probate and estate matters and the Surrogate's Court relationship to the Probate Part.
sources.limit: The glossary defines the court role; it does not determine who has authority in a particular estate or resolve a contested matter.

sources.publisher: New Jersey Department of the Treasury
sources.title: Surrogate Court Documentation and County Contacts
sources.use: Explains that each New Jersey county has a Surrogate Court and provides statewide office contacts for probate-document questions.
sources.limit: The page is framed around unclaimed-property documentation and should be used as a contact path, not as legal advice for selling real estate.

sources.title: Assessment and Appeals
sources.use: Supports April 1 and May 1 filing language, alternative-calendar counties, assessment standards, forms, and county-board paths.
sources.limit: Deadlines and procedures can turn on notices, calendar rules, property type, value, and county practice; users must verify the current route directly.

sources.title: Petition of Appeal Form A-1 and Instructions (6-26)
sources.use: Supports filed-and-received language, the 45-day bulk-mailing alternative, May 1 revaluation treatment, January 15 counties, and valuation evidence rules.
sources.limit: The form instructions must be read in full and checked with the applicable county; this page does not complete a filing or evaluate evidence.

sources.title: A Guide to Tax Appeal Hearings
sources.use: Supports the distinction between appealing an assessment and appealing the amount of taxes, plus the State's general evidence framework.
sources.limit: The guide is general and not all-inclusive; it does not promise a reduction, select comparable sales, or replace legal or appraisal advice.

sources.title: County Tax Administrators and County Assessor
sources.use: Provides the current statewide contact list for county boards of taxation and county tax administrators.
sources.limit: Contact details can change; users should confirm the current county office, delivery method, hearing option, and deadline before filing.

sources.title: Property Taxpayer Bill of Rights
sources.use: Supports access to understandable assessment information, appeal procedures, time limits, and property-record information.
sources.limit: The page states taxpayer information rights and does not decide the value, evidence, timeliness, or outcome of an individual appeal.

sources.title: 2024-2025 School Performance Reports
sources.use: Provides current 2024-25 report-year records, definitions, and methodology for an address-specific review of official public-school data.

sources.title: Trip Planner
